LocalizationTwist.description: Represents linear and angular velocities for localization.

elements.description: Array of individual light elements within the traffic light.

traffic_light_id.description: Unique identifier for the traffic light.

traffic_light_type.description: Type of traffic light (e.g., pedestrian, vehicle).

TrafficLight.description: Represents a traffic light with its properties and elements.

color.description: Color of the light element (e.g., red, yellow, green).

confidence.description: Confidence level of the light element detection.

shape.description: Shape of the light element (e.g., circle, arrow).

status.description: Current status of the light element (e.g., on, off, blinking).

TrafficLightElement.description: Represents an individual element of a traffic light.

heading_rate_rps.description: Heading rate in radians per second.

is_final.description: True if this is the final point in the path.

lateral_velocity_mps.description: Lateral velocity in meters per second.

longitudinal_velocity_mps.description: Longitudinal velocity in meters per second.

PathPoint.description: Represents a point on a planned path.

left_bound.description: Array of points defining the left boundary.

points.description: Array of points defining the planning path.

right_bound.description: Array of points defining the right boundary.

PlanningPath.description: A planning path definition for Autoware.

acceleration_mps2.description: Acceleration in meters per second squared.

heading_rate_rps.description: Heading rate in radians per second.

lateral_velocity_mps.description: Lateral velocity in meters per second.

longitudinal_velocity_mps.description: Longitudinal velocity in meters per second.

time_from_start.description: Time from start of the trajectory.

rmse_rotation_x.description: Root mean square error of the rotation [rad] (x axes corresponding to roll).

rmse_rotation_y.description: Root mean square error of the rotation [rad] (y axes corresponding to pitch).

rmse_rotation_z.description: Root mean square error of the rotation [rad] (z axes corresponding to yaw).

GnssInsOrientation.description: GNSS (Global Navigation Satellite System) INS (Inertial Navigation System) orientation message.

VelocityReport.description: Represents the velocity report of a vehicle.

altitude.description: Altitude [m]. Positive is above the WGS 84 ellipsoid (quiet NaN if no altitude is available).

latitude.description: Latitude [degrees]. Positive is north of equator; negative is south.

longitude.description: Longitude [degrees]. Positive is east of prime meridian; negative is west.

position_covariance.description: Position covariance [m^2] defined relative to a tangential plane through the reported position. The components are East, North, and Up (ENU), in row-major order.

position_covariance_type.description: Type of position covariance (0: UNKNOWN, 1: APPROXIMATED, 2: DIAGONAL_KNOWN, 3: KNOWN).

NavSatFix.description: Global navigation satellite system (GNSS) fix data.

service.description: Service indicator for the navigation system.

status.description: Status indicator for the navigation system.

NavSatStatus.description: Represents the status of a navigation satellite system.

fields.description: Describes the channels and their layout in the binary data blob.

height.description: 2D structure of the point cloud. If the cloud is unordered, height is 1 and width is the length of the point cloud.

is_dense.description: True if there are no invalid points.

point_step.description: Length of a point in bytes.

row_step.description: Length of a row in bytes.

width.description: 2D structure of the point cloud. If the cloud is unordered, height is 1 and width is the length of the point cloud.

PointCloud2.description: Represents a point cloud with a flexible format.

count.description: How many elements in the field.

datatype.description: Datatype enumeration (1: INT8, 2: UINT8, 3: INT16, 4: UINT16, 5: INT32, 6: UINT32, 7: FLOAT32, 8: FLOAT64).

offset.description: Offset from start of point struct.

PointField.description: Represents a field in a point cloud.
